decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Time 11:38 2022 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 20 - 23 October 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 35), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The following Power Unit Elements have been used: 6th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) 4th Energy Store (ES) 4th Control Electronics (CE)
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The changed PU elements were replaced whilst the car was in parc ferme without the approval of the Technical Delegate. As the PU elements were changed without approval of the Technical Delegate this is not in accordance with Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. The competitor is therefore required to start the race from the pit lane per article 40.9 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 31 Changes Under Parc Ferme
